request.summary: Create a retail product catalog that keeps product copy quick-editable while images remain independently managed in Wallboard File System.
request.audience: Customers browsing a curated collection on shared retail signage.
request.primaryGoal: Present one product at a time with editorial impact, reliable image lookup, and a clear fallback when media is unavailable.

assumptions: The operator creates the Products TABLE from the supplied table sample and binds it to products.
The operator uploads the supplied synthetic JPG files to File System, exposes that folder as a datasource, and binds it to productImages.
Products.imageKey matches the File System filename without its extension.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: Retail signage may use full-screen landscape, portrait endcaps, compact displays, or wide shelf strips.

surfaces.purpose: Primary editorial retail display with deliberate page margins.
Wide shelf display with a bounded image and editorial copy strip.
Compact square display with a narrow outer margin.

ownership.rationale: The generated visual identity, layout modes, and fallback treatment stay code-owned.
Operators may tailor the collection voice without changing code.
Operators can tune media treatment and the compact visual palette.
Operators control cadence and may disable motion.
Product content and ordering are quick-editable TABLE rows.
Product photography is managed independently in File System.

views.purpose: Show one product with its matched image, copy, details, price, and availability.
Show a designed collection message when no valid products exist.

session.expectation: The passive catalog keeps rotating from its current product.

rendering.rationale: The image and copy reflow between horizontal, vertical, compact, and wide-low compositions.

motion.rationale: A short entrance transition marks product changes; Off removes it while preserving rotation.

media.fallback: Render the panel-colored geometric product treatment and category label.
media.rationale: The TABLE remains easy to edit while File System handles binary assets and the app uses the platform media interceptor.

branding.provenance: No customer brand was supplied; Field Note is a synthetic retail identity.
branding.fallback: Use the generated editorial palette, typographic contrast, and brand label setting.

settings.purpose: Sets the compact retail brand line.
Selects Off, Subtle, or Expressive transition motion.
Selects Cover or Contain for matched product images.
Sets primary text and line color.
Sets badge, availability, and progress accent.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep one line and reduce to the room-readable minimum before ellipsizing.
dynamicText.rationale: The collection statement must remain complete in the masthead whenever space permits.

dynamicText.fallback: Use two lines and preserve the readable minimum; omit secondary copy before shrinking further.
dynamicText.rationale: The product name is the primary room-reading target.

dynamicText.fallback: Hide overflow only in compact and wide-low surfaces after preserving the product name, price, and image.
dynamicText.rationale: Description length varies but must not displace price or availability.

states.expectation: Image and copy stack into a full-height retail endcap composition.
The shelf-strip layout keeps image, name, price, and availability visible.
Compact signage preserves the primary retail hierarchy and omits lower-priority details.
Long collection, name, and description text remain readable and contained.
Missing File System matches use the designed geometric fallback.
No valid rows render the configured empty collection message.
The final product remains a complete page before circular rotation.
TABLE edits update visible copy without resetting the active product unnecessarily.
Rotation remains functional while page transition animation is disabled.

behaviors.expectation: Products rotate in stable order, wrap circularly, never show an empty frame, and clean up the instance timer.
Products.imageKey resolves against File System filenames by filename stem.
Missing and broken image records render the designed fallback.

visualDirection.summary: A warm editorial retail spread with real product photography, serif display type, visible folio, and restrained technical metadata.
signatureChoices: One large unframed product image rather than a product-card grid.
Serif product names against compact uppercase catalog metadata.
Geometric color-led image fallback that belongs to the same visual system.
avoid: Generic dark operations dashboards or nested cards.
Automatic styling copied from unrelated examples.
Shrinking room-readable copy to preserve low-priority details.

visualReview.intent: The result should feel like a real curated retail campaign while remaining operationally simple to update.
focus: Inspect actual image crops and fallback states across all declared surfaces.
Verify long product copy never clips descenders or displaces price and availability.
Confirm the transition communicates change without hiding content or creating blank frames.
